leaf_kcs.name: Verification is necessary but not sufficient
leaf_kcs.knowledge_description: Verification is a prerequisite for opening the gate, not proof that the verified signal is useful.
leaf_kcs.observable_claim: Given a new case, the learner can distinguish a prerequisite from a guarantee.

source_evidence.description: The first source states verification as a prerequisite.
The second source denies that verification guarantees utility.

context_evidence.excerpt: Ask learners to distinguish a prerequisite from a guarantee.
context_evidence.supports: The lecturer wants this distinction assessed.

assessment_slots.evidence_intent: Distinguish a satisfied prerequisite from an unsupported guarantee in a new case.

questions.title: Interpret a verified signal

stimulus.text: A signal passed verification, but no evidence establishes whether it is useful.

choice_options.text: Verification is complete; usefulness is still unproven.
Verification is complete; usefulness is now guaranteed.
Verification failed; usefulness is still unproven.
Verification failed; usefulness is now guaranteed.

questions.answer_explanation: Passing verification satisfies the stated prerequisite, while the second source says it does not establish usefulness.

hints.text: Separate what the case establishes from what remains unsupported.
